description: A broadsheet magazine — 'The Dispatch'. Stacked newspaper masthead with a Fraunces nameplate, a cover-story lead in high-contrast display serif, a full-width pull-quote band over a generative topographic-contour engraving, an asymmetric features well, and a department-grouped table of contents. Lora serif reading column with drop caps, folios, and double rules on warm ivory newsprint with a single claret accent.
